request.source:
-- 只读复核历史木材对象和州容量字段；不修改内存、断点或运行状态。
local context = debug_getCurrentContextTable(false)
local goods = 0x3A4012E4A60
local length = readQword(goods + 0x28)
local capacity = readQword(goods + 0x30)
local name = nil
if length == 4 and capacity == 15 then name = readString(goods + 0x18, 5, false) end
return {
    pid=getOpenedProcessID(), moduleBase=string.format('%X', getAddress('victoria3.exe')),
    stopped=type(context) == 'table',
    rip=type(context) == 'table' and string.format('%X', context.RIP) or '',
    goodsAddress=string.format('%X', goods), goodsId=readInteger(goods + 0x10),
    goodsName=name or '', nameLength=length, nameCapacity=capacity,
    stateAddress='3A484D9DB60', tableAddress='3A484D9F8E8',
    capacity1D58=readInteger(0x3A484D9DB60 + 0x1D58),
    capacity1D5C=readInteger(0x3A484D9DB60 + 0x1D5C),
}
